{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.48","title":"radio.py: polling capture still fires on_rx_timeout after success","description":"## Problem

Callback RX at timeout is fail-closed: RadioMixin._handle_rx_timeout calls deliver_pending_packets, and if the node leaves RX_WAIT it returns without super()._handle_rx_timeout. Observers see on_rx_success only.

Polling RX (start_receive / RX_WAIT with rx_callbacks is None) does not. After _capture_polling_rx records the frame (on_rx_success + metrics.record_reception), state is still RX_WAIT, so the method falls through to _drop_delayed_rx_for_receiver and EventHandlersMixin._handle_rx_timeout, which sets IDLE and notifies on_rx_timeout.

Same-tick DelayedRxReady + RxTimeout (the 9098.40 path) therefore emits both events for one window. Dashboard / RecordingObserver / any client that treats on_rx_timeout as "nothing arrived" will drop or mis-account a packet that get_rx_result still returns from _pending_poll_rx.

test_same_tick_timeout_does_not_drop_delayed_callback asserts timed_out == [] for the callback API. test_same_tick_timeout_delivers_polling_rx does not install an observer.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (_handle_rx_timeout, _capture_polling_rx)
- python/src/lichen/sim/events.py (SimulationObserver.on_rx_timeout vs on_rx_success)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py
- python/tests/sim/test_observer.py (test_rx_timeout_event has no overlapping success)
